git_rationale.root_cause_commit: e2007ff - fix: 6 HTML generator issues + timeline agent travel_segments schema
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Commit e2007ff added native travel_segments generation to timeline.md but instructions said 'For every gap between consecutive activities that involves travel' without distinguishing intra-city (taxi, metro) from inter-city (train, flight). This caused timeline agent to incorrectly add inter-city transport (like train D5121 from Bazhong to Chengdu) to both timeline object AND travel_segments array, creating data duplication and violating architectural separation where timeline contains ALL activities but travel_segments is only for short intra-city UI rendering hops.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added explicit CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL RULE section at line 157 (before travel_segments generation logic) that clearly separates intra-city transport (belongs in travel_segments) from inter-city transport (belongs ONLY in timeline object, NOT travel_segments). Rule includes whitelist (taxi, metro, walk, bus, ferry), blacklist (train, flight, location_change), and validation rule to exclude transportation.json location_change entries. This prevents future timeline agent runs from duplicating inter-city transport into travel_segments.

architectural_clarification.timeline_object_purpose: Contains ALL activities including inter-city transport (train D5121), intra-city transport (taxi), meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, hotel check-in/out
architectural_clarification.travel_segments_purpose: Contains ONLY intra-city transport for UI rendering of short hops between consecutive activities (taxi to restaurant, metro to attraction, walk between nearby POIs)
architectural_clarification.location_change_field: Marks inter-city transport in transportation.json that should appear in timeline but NOT in travel_segments
architectural_clarification.separation_of_concerns: timeline = comprehensive schedule, travel_segments = UI rendering of local movement
